entry.title: Password, Session, Cookie, Token, JWT, SSO, OAuth - Authentication Explained - Part 2
entry.summary: ** ** When it comes to authentication, there are three factors to consider: Knowledge factors: something you know, such as a password Ownership factors: something you own, such as a device or phone number Inherence factors: something unique to you, such as your biometric features Passwords fall under “something you know”. One-Time Passwords (OTP) prove that the user owns a cell phone or a device, while biometric authentication proves "something unique to you". ** ** However, it's important to note that using SMS as the delivery method for OTPs can be less secure than other methods. This is because SMS messages can be intercepted or redirected by hackers, particularly if the user's phone number has been compromised.
